tone.voice: a friend who got you the best tickets — enthusiastic, in the know, reliable

trust_signals: official event partner or verified organiser badge
secure payment and refund policy visibility
event capacity and sold out signals
ux_norms: urgency is a design element — sold out, limited spots, countdown timers
event imagery is large and immersive
seat map or venue layout for ticketed events
add to calendar is always a post-purchase action
QR code ticket always accessible in wallet
group booking and split payment expected
discovery by date, category, and location
share event is a primary social action

visual_language.primary_type: real photography and bold graphic vectors
visual_language.style: high energy — event photography, dramatic lighting, crowd energy
photography_rules: event and venue photography drives all decisions
crowd and atmosphere shots for hero sections
performer and artist photography high priority
never use generic stock events imagery
visual_language.background_treatment: dark and dramatic for premium events — bold colour for festivals and parties
visual_language.empty_state_style: bold SVG — ticket, microphone, or stage — with energetic copy
visual_language.onboarding_visual: bold graphic vector — stage, crowd, or event silhouette
visual_language.illustration_style: bold graphic vector — high contrast, event poster aesthetic

compliance_notes: consumer protection for refunds and cancellations
